title: Heart rate zones
description: Time spent per HR zone (mart.hr_zone_time), derived from the 1 bpm histogram: recomputable for any set of boundaries with a plain REFRESH (COMMENT ON MATERIALIZED VIEW mart.hr_zone_time).

list.name: athlete_id
list.query: SELECT a.athlete_id AS __value, a.display_name AS __text FROM core.athlete a ORDER BY a.athlete_id
list.definition: SELECT a.athlete_id AS __value, a.display_name AS __text FROM core.athlete a ORDER BY a.athlete_id

panels.title: Time per zone — timeline
panels.description: Seconds per zone (mart.hr_zone_time.zone_code), per day, stacked.

targets.rawSql: SELECT z.local_date::timestamp AS time, z.zone_code AS metric, sum(z.seconds) AS value FROM mart.hr_zone_time z JOIN core.activity a ON a.activity_id = z.activity_id WHERE a.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND $__timeFilter(z.local_date) GROUP BY z.local_date, z.zone_code ORDER BY z.local_date

panels.title: Total time per zone — selected period
panels.description: Sum of seconds per zone_code over the period, ordered by mart.hr_zone_time.zone_order. zone_order drives the ordering only and is kept out of the projection: a bar chart plots every numeric column it receives, so leaving it in drew the zone index (1, 2, 3, 4) as a series of its own next to the real durations.

targets.rawSql: SELECT z.zone_code AS "Zone", sum(z.seconds) AS "Time in zone" FROM mart.hr_zone_time z JOIN core.activity a ON a.activity_id = z.activity_id WHERE a.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND $__timeFilter(z.local_date) GROUP BY z.zone_code ORDER BY min(z.zone_order)
